title: Test-kit kit.json
description: Paths are relative to the folder that holds kit.json. The contest supplies this data; the library holds all code.

labels.description: labels.json: header labels on every page, the pages, their labels in order and each label's value kind. Page: {labels: [{name, kind: text|number|date|money|list|code, rule_words?}], repeat?: label that starts a new row, prefix?: page-name prefix that maps to this page}.

case_data.description: Case-data JSON: {cases: [{id, title, prompt, steps: [{step, expert, reply}], person: {file: text}, served: {file: text}, key: {PAGE: [{label: value | {value, group, match}}]}}]}

dirs.description: Folders for cases, keys, runs, scores, prompts (defaults: the same names).

entry.description: The entry under test, for trace.py.

plugin.description: Python file with optional score_extra(case, key, status, pages, text) and replay_extra(case, key, status, pages, text, transcript).
